{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Diagnostic

|descr= Starts recording units position and events for an '''AAR''' (After Action Review).<br>
The following keys must be added to [[Description.ext]] for AAR to work properly:
<syntaxhighlight lang="cpp">
diagAAR = 1;		// to enable diag AAR
diagAARauthor = 1;	// if description.ext/dev == profileName, allows the creator to debug himself
diagAARunits = 2;	// which units to record:
						// 1 = units player
						// 2 = allunits + alldead
						// any other value = player
diagAARdelay = 3;	// delay between recording steps
</syntaxhighlight>
The data can be accessed with <sqf inline>profileNamespace getVariable "BIS_fnc_diagAAR_data"</sqf>.

|s1= call [[BIS_fnc_diagAARrecord]]

|r1= [[Number]] - the FSM handle (see [[execFSM]])

|x1= <sqf>call BIS_fnc_diagAARrecord;</sqf>

|seealso= [[BIS_fnc_diagAAR]]
}}
